meta.source: Simulated readings (tools/make_geneva_fake.py) on real Geneva buildings: SITG public data
rules: heat = gas x 0.90 (gross -> net) + district heat + oil + pellets
oil and pellets: deliveries, not measured use
negative values and abnormal spikes found by the import checks: replaced by the median of the same month in other years
heat-pump heat (heat_hp) = heat meter where there is one, else pump electricity x the COP measured that month at the sites with a heat meter (estimated)
heat index = (heat + heat_hp) / SRE, in MJ/m2 per year (kWh x 3.6): approximate, not weather-corrected, not the official IDC
municipal housing: electricity covers common areas only
meta.targets_source: City of Geneva climate strategy (our choice)
